text:
lina: Heads up — planning a rolling reboot in us-west2 to push NIC microcode and clear a latent interrupt. Target window: Tue 03/24 02:00-04:00 UTC. We'll do cohorted cordon+drain of GPU pools (50 nodes per cohort).
ben: ETA on capacity impact? customers running high-throughput dedicated pools.
lina: Expect ~12-18% transient capacity reduction in us-west2 during the window, but we'll keep burst routing to other regions. Non-critical spot workloads should be evicted first.
oncall-night: Can we do a canary cohort first (5 nodes) and validate egress path + KV cache warmup before bulk drains? Also what's rollback plan if we see packet loss spikes?
infra-bot: Scheduled maintenance event created: ID maint-20260324-usw2-nic. Notifications sent to affected tenants.
lina: Yes — canary first. Plan:
- 02:00 UTC: canary cohort cordon -> drain -> nic microcode apply -> reboot -> smoke egress tests 
- 02:15 UTC: validate KV cache hitrate and model tail latency for in-flight sessions
- 02:30 UTC: if green, roll cohorts every 10m with overlap for warmbackfill.
If packet loss >0.5% sustained or p95 latency jumps > 300ms, abort and rollback nodes to previous firmware.
maria: Cost question — should we request temporary reserved burst for Dedicated customers or just rely on cross-region failover? Reserved will cost ~ $8k for 4h but would keep latency SLOs.
ben: If we rely on cross-region, egress costs + cold KV cache penalty might be higher than $8k. Need a quick calc: estimated reroute tokens cost ~= $1.2k/h + 20% perf penalty.
sam: Suggest hybrid: reserve minimal burst for priority tenants (SLA customers) and force non-critical tasks into interruptible. That keeps customer-facing trajectories stable.
lina: Agreed. Action items:
- @maria: please approve 4h burst reservation for priority tenants, cap $9k.
- @ben: prepare eviction list for spot/intermittent jobs and notify schedulers.
- @oncall-night: own canary run and green-check gates.
- @sam: update routing policy to prefer eu/us fallback for generation-heavy routes.
Commands I'll run for each cohort (copy-paste):
```
kubectl cordon gpu-node-<cohort-id>-<n>
kubectl drain gpu-node-<cohort-id>-<n> --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
apply-microcode --id nic-fw-20260324 --node gpu-node-<cohort-id>-<n>
reboot-node gpu-node-<cohort-id>-<n>
```
ben: I'll attach the eviction list to the ticket. Also adding a prom alert tweak for tcp_retransmits and kv_cache_misses during the window.
oncall-night: I'll run the egress sanity script post-reboot: `scripts/egress_sanity.sh --targets=all --threshold=0.5` and post results.
infra-bot: Canary started by @oncall-night at 1765439999.
oncall-night: Canary report: egress latency p50/p95 stable, retransmits 0.12%, kv_cache_miss briefly spiked to 8% for 45s while warmup ran — within expected. Rolling to cohort 2.
ben: Evictions triggered, spot jobs bumped.
maria: Approved burst reserve. Funding code CHG-OPS-302 approved.
sam: Routing policy pushed and verified in staging, will flip at 02:28 UTC after second cohort heat.
lina: Timeline update: on schedule, cohorts 3-6 in progress, tracking in the maint ticket. If anyone sees unusual error rates, ping me and @oncall-night.
ben: Noted. :thumbsup:
oncall-night: All cohorts complete, final smoke looks good. Reboot window finished at 03:55 UTC. No rollback required.
lina: Huge thanks team. I'll keep maint ticket open for 24h to watch for latent regressions. :white_check_mark:
